title: Kitchen Warmed Chinese Sweet Rice Flour Chow Fun
description: A traditional Chinese dish featuring sweet rice flour chapssalgaru, cooked to perfection in a donabe vessel, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this ovo-vegetarian friendly recipe is earthy and flaky in texture, served in a form of chow fun.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the sweet rice flour and water, stirring until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a long rope.
Cut the rope into 1/2 inch pieces to form the chow fun noodles.
Heat the vegetable oil in a donabe vessel over medium heat.
Add the scallions and mushrooms to the donabe and cook until they are softened.
Add the soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper to the donabe and stir to combine.
Add the chow fun noodles to the donabe and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Push the noodles to one side of the donabe and add the beaten eggs to the other side.
Scramble the eggs until they are cooked through, then mix with the noodles and vegetables.
Cook the mixture for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, using a bain-marie if necessary to prevent burning.
